title: CreatureDefinition
description: One creature JSON document (src/server/content/creatures/<creature-id>.json). Creatures have no ATK/DEF — an attack is a pile cost plus an effect. Every legal squad has exactly one legendary.

life.description: Max life. Damage lives on CreatureState so the definition never desyncs.

attributes.description: One attribute, or two for dual-colour legendaries / bridges.

legendary.description: Commander-style win target. Omit / false = non-legendary. Defeating the opposing legendary wins the match.

passiveRulesText.description: English passive text as printed under the art. Empty string when none.

standingAbilities.description: Data-driven standing passives (spec 010). Prefer relation filters on shared hooks (on-absorb, on-attack, …) over special-cased reducer branches.

attacks.description: Printed attacks. Typically one basic and one special. Each has kind, optional requires / discards, range, rulesText, optional effect and followUpEffects.
